overview_description.description: Bezi is a development tool for Unity that helps manage game assets, scenes, packages, and code. It can write, edit, and implement scripts based on the project’s style. The tool can generate shaders, create documentation, and provide instructions for the project. Bezi identifies errors and traces interactions between scripts, objects, and components to find solutions. It offers an Agent Mode that executes tasks directly within the Unity editor. Developers, artists, and designers can use it to reduce coding and debugging time. The tool keeps project data private with end-to-end encryption and does not use content for AI training.

about_short_description.short_description: Bezi is an AI development tool for Unity that helps manage game assets, scenes, packages, and code.

product.name: Debug
product.description: Tool to identify problematic scripts, components, and scene interactions in Unity projects to facilitate error resolution.

product.name: Code
product.description: Provides code suggestions tailored to existing scripts, assets, and packages within a Unity project to assist development.

product.name: Search
product.description: Indexes Unity projects to locate assets, identify missing components, and find relevant scripts quickly.

product.name: Learn
product.description: Breaks down complex game systems in Unity projects to help developers understand project structure and logic without extensive documentation.
